main_text.l: GENEROSÆ ET ANTIQVISSIMÆ NOBILITATIS, DOMINO GEORGIO SIGISMVNDO, Prakschicky à Zastrisel, Domino Buchlouij, Serauitij, &c. Moravo.

VM clarissimorum virorum doctissimas lucubrationes lego, Nobilissime Domine, quę non tam tui ornandi, quàm honestissima studia tua iuvandi & promouendi gratia, sub tuo inclyto nomine, in lucem illi ediderunt: continuò & ipse mecum cogitare cœpi, merito me reprehendi posse

page.notes: The decorated initial D is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "VM" with the initial D joined to the following word as printed ("DVM"). The ornamental initial is read as D; the first word is DUM with the D from the woodcut. The text is set in roman with an italic signature line. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
